said: A new type needs equivalent getters, or the filing falls in none of them and vanishes.
evidence: rootStore.ts:145-165: only isContinuationInTodo/Pending/Filing list CHANGE_REQUESTED, AWAITING_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED; isRegistrationTodo (l.200) etc. only DRAFT/PENDING, isRegistrationFiling only COMPLETED/PAID. Every getter is gated on bootstrapFilingType.
note: True during the review statuses (and for a brand-new type string in all statuses); an existing type like registration/IA/amalgamation still shows for DRAFT/PENDING/PAID/COMPLETED. Reference is the more precise statement.

said: core/filing.py and models/filing.py get_document_list, plus business_documents._get_receipt, already allow AWAITING_REVIEW, CHANGE_REQUESTED, APPROVED and REJECTED for any type.
evidence: core/filing.py:519-536: no_legal_filings_in_paid_status = [REGISTRATION, CONSENTCONTINUATIONOUT, CONTINUATIONOUT, AGMEXTENSION, AGMLOCATIONCHANGE] plus SP/GP dissolution excluded with 'not (filing.filing_type in no_legal_filings_in_paid_status ...)'. models/filing.py has no get_document_list (only core/filing.py:475). business_documents.py _get_receipt does allow the review statuses for any type.

said: If you don't generalise them or add equivalents, the new filing disappears from the dashboard after payment. It would be in none of the lists.
evidence: rootStore.ts:145-165,200-218: after payment a reviewed filing is AWAITING_REVIEW, which only isContinuationInPending matches; registration/IA/amalgamation getters accept only DRAFT/PENDING (todo) and COMPLETED/PAID (history). So it vanishes while under review, but DRAFT/PENDING/PAID/COMPLETED still show for an existing type.
note: Consistent with the reference for review statuses; overstated if read as vanishing in all statuses.

evidence: entity-pay worker.py:127-136: after the email, 'if not filing_submission.effective_date or ... <= utcnow(): await publish_filing(filing_submission)' (publish to FILER subject, l.73-78). No review branch exists.

said: A new type with no equivalent getters will fall into none of these lists, so the filing disappears from the customer's view.
evidence: rootStore.ts:222-247 isBootstrapTodo/Pending/Filing OR the per-type getters, each gated on bootstrapFilingType and a status list; review statuses appear only in continuation-in getters.
note: True for a brand-new type string or for review statuses; not for an existing type's DRAFT/PENDING/PAID/COMPLETED.

said: pay-queue (worker.py) handles CAS, CGI and EFT files, not this event.
evidence: pay-queue resources/worker.py:44-52 dispatches CAS, CGI ack/feedback, EFT, INCORPORATION/REGISTRATION only (no PAYMENT consumer). But services/payment_reconciliations.py:461 calls _publish_payment_event(inv) for ONLINE_BANKING during reconcile_payments (CAS), and l.657-667 publishes QueueMessageTypes.PAYMENT with PaymentStatus.COMPLETED.
note: Right that worker.py does not consume the event; wrong if it implies pay-queue does not produce it (reconciliation of CAS files does, for online banking).

said: lear/legal-api uses Filing.Status.COMPLETED, which is its own filing state and a different thing.
evidence: legal-api only compares payment_status_code to 'CREATED' (business_tasks.py v2:118, v1:111); it never compares it to COMPLETED (the UI does). Filing.Status.COMPLETED is the filing state, but models/filing.py:45 'COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"' is the same literal, and entity-pay worker.py:114 compares the payment statusCode with Filing.Status.COMPLETED.value, so it is coupled to the pay-api string.

said: It sends statusCode = COMPLETED only if the invoice is PAID. Otherwise it sends TRANSACTION_FAILED.
evidence: payment_transaction.py:496-503: if transaction COMPLETED and invoice not PAID -> logs and 'return' (nothing published); else (transaction not COMPLETED) status_code = 'TRANSACTION_FAILED'.

said: A renamed value falls through to logger.error('Unknown payment status') and raises QueueException. That gives retries
evidence: entity-pay worker.py:140-146 logs and raises QueueException, but cb_subscription_handler l.168-171 'except (QueueException, Exception): ... message is removed from the queue' (only OperationalError is re-raised, l.157). So no retry; dropped.

evidence: entity-filer worker.py:107-137 publish_event: 'type': 'bc.registry.business.' + filing.filing_type (NATS), and l.143-175 publish_gcp_queue_event type='bc.registry.business.' + filing.filing_type; called at l.409 and l.420.

said: That maps state to the entity status, validated by schemas/schemas/entity.json.
evidence: auth-api services/entity.py:166-169 maps 'state' to 'status'. resources/v1/entity.py:50,88 validate the PATCH body with schema 'entity'; entity.json defines state as {type: string, pattern: '^(.*)$'} with additionalProperties false, so it checks only that it is a string; any value passes.
reference_fix: In sbc-auth, auth-api's EntityService.update_entity renames the incoming 'state' key to 'status' and stores it in the entity's status column; the PATCH endpoint validates the body against entity.json, but state is only a string with pattern '^(.*)$', so any value is accepted.

said: affiliations-factory.ts then looks it up with BusinessState[business.status]
evidence: auth-web composables/affiliations-factory.ts:86 and :106 'return BusinessState[business.status]'; stores/business.ts:111 'status: determineStatus(resp)' (resp.state || resp.draftStatus per fact). Consistent with the reference, which says the enum is keyed by that name.
note: Code-supported and not in conflict with the reference; the judge's dispute likely stems from other wording in the answer.
